A smaller reference card sits nearby, connected to the sage insert by one fine, unbroken green line, making clear that the missing information came from a source. Include two tiny restrained check marks beside the completed cards. Keep the record cards distinct and intact, suggesting preserved identities. The visual story should communicate careful inspection, source-supported correction, and verified completion. No people, faces, anthropomorphic computers, dramatic lighting, celebration, or readable text. This is a visual metaphor for an orderly data-cleaning process, not a depiction of a felt emotional experience.
